## What would you like to see

One or two sentences. If it is a model or an op, name the computation; if it is a view,
describe what the learner should be able to read off it.

## Why it helps someone learn

What idea becomes visible that is hard to see today?

## Scope check

neuroviz-lab is a learning visualizer: small models, real values, step by step. It is not
a training framework, an MLOps tool or an explainability toolkit. Does this request fit?
See `ROADMAP.md` for what is planned and what is not.

## Anything else

Sketches, references, or an example of the numbers you would expect to see.
